description: This file contains automated integration tests for the CatalogItem API endpoints in the eShopOnWeb project. It tests filtering, pagination, and URI composition for catalog items.

classes.name: CatalogItemListPagedEndpoint_FiltersAndPageCount
classes.description: A test class for verifying the behavior of the CatalogItem endpoints, including filtering, pagination, and URI handling.

methods.name: ReturnsFilteredByBrandOrType
methods.description: Test method that verifies filtering catalog items by brand and type IDs.

methods.name: PageSizeZeroReturnsAllAndPageCountPositive
methods.description: Test method verifying behavior when page size is set to zero, expecting all items returned and a positive page count.

methods.name: PictureUriIsComposed
methods.description: Test method that ensures PictureUri fields are properly composed and do not contain placeholder base URLs.
